info.headline: Notify NYC - Silver Alert - Zhu Lan Tongzhu
info.description:
Silver Alert issued 10-26-2026 at 01:00 PM.
A Silver Alert has been issued for Zhu Lan Tongzhu, a 65-year-old Asian Female, last seen near Lexington Avenue and East 26th Street in Manhattan at approximately 5:30 PM on 10-25-2026. Zhu Lan has dementia, may seem disoriented, and may be in need of medical attention.
Description: gray hair. Last seen wearing: unknown.
If you see Zhu Lan, please call 1-800-577-8477 (TIPS) or 9-1-1.
A photo of Zhu Lan is available here: https://flic.kr/p/2sJowhm
